subject: Escalation: Cloud channel deal — rev-share exception & term alignment for Skyward Analytics
messages:
From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@skywardanalytics.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Channel opportunity — Skyward Analytics (Azure listing)

Hi David / Marissa,

Thanks again for the call earlier. To move procurement along on our side we need a one-off rev-share and term alignment for the Azure channel listing. Legal at Skyward has flagged the standard revenue split as too low given they will be buying through their enterprise agreement and require a 24-month minimum term. The ask is: 18% rev-share to Skyward and a 24-month commitment with a pricing cap clause. Procurement also requested an appendix describing how usage metering and refunds would work for committed spend.

We can sign quickly if Redwood can provide an approved exception (they need that to present to their procurement committee on Monday). Attached is a quick spend forecast from Skyward.

Ayesha
Skyward Analytics

Attachments: skyward_usage_forecast_q3_q4.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Deal Desk <deal.desk@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Channel opportunity — Skyward Analytics (Azure listing) — Requesting exec signoff for rev-share/term exception

Team — forwarding Skyward's ask. Short ask from sales: approve a one-time exception to increase partner/partner-customer rev-share to 18% and allow a 24-month term with a pricing cap addendum for Azure channel listings. Economics: forecasted committed ARR ~ $780k over 24 months (see attached model). With 18% rev-share the incremental margin hit is ~6.5% of ARR vs. our baseline marketplace economics, but it unlocks a large enterprise procurement door and a planned expansion in EU next year.

Why I’m escalating: this exceeds standard channel rev-share thresholds (our standard is 12–14% for channel deals) and includes a term longer than our default 12 months. Skyward is ready to sign conditioned on getting a Redwood exec ok and a short legal appendix to cover metering/refunds.

Requesting approvals:
- Marissa: Sales approval for revenue tradeoff and strategic rationale
- Lauren: Partnerships/Channel approval for listing policy exception and rev-share
- Jordan: Legal to confirm appendix language is acceptable or flag redlines

Attachments: skyward_revshare_model.xlsx, cloud_terms_redline.pdf

Can we get a quick decision today? Skyward needs confirmation by Monday EOD to keep their procurement timeline.

Thanks,
David
Senior Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2026 11:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Channel opportunity — Skyward Analytics — Requesting exec signoff

David — thanks for the context and the model. High level: I’m supportive of making a strategic concession here to win Skyward, but need two conditions met before I sign off: 1) legal-approved appendix that limits our liability on committed spend metering and outlines refund mechanics; 2) an internal cap on cumulative exposure across all similar channel exceptions for the quarter (I want to avoid setting a precedent we can’t track).

Jordan — can you review the attached redline (cloud_terms_redline.pdf) and advise whether the proposed appendix language is minimal risk? If legal can clean up and sign off on liability/refund clauses, I’ll approve the 18% rev-share and 24-month term from a sales perspective. Also cc ing Lauren since this touches channel listing policy.

If we need CFO or CRO final signature, call it out — otherwise I’ll provide approval via email to keep Skyward moving.

Marissa
VP, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

On Sun, Jun 20, 2026 at 09:08 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick read: Appendix looks reasonable but need to tighten the refund triggers and cap our exposure to chargebacks. I will draft a narrow addendum and share by EOD.
>
> — Jordan

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Channel opportunity — Skyward Analytics — Requesting exec signoff

Marissa / Team — I’ve reviewed the economics and the redline Jordan circulated. From Partnerships/Channel policy perspective I approve the following conditional exceptions:

- Rev-share: 18% to Skyward (one-off for this account)
- Term: 24 months allowed for this listing with a pricing cap clause (as drafted in the addendum)
- Exposure control: Deal Desk to record this as an "exception-class" and we will not approve further similar exceptions exceeding $1.5M aggregate ARR this quarter without CRO notice.

Jordan — please finalize the legal addendum and loop in Contracts for execution. David — once legal signs off, send the DocuSign link back to Ayesha and copy me. I will confirm partner listing policy exception in writing so Skyward can present to procurement.

Lauren
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: skyward_revshare_model.xlsx, cloud_terms_redline.pdf

-----Original Message-----
On Sun, 20 Jun 2026 at 09:08 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Draft addendum attached. Tightened refund triggers and introduced a quarterly exposure cap. Happy to iterate if needed.
>
> Jordan
